claim_boundary: The 36/50 result is task-level pass@k over up to 10-20 attempts. The wall-clock curve contains heavily overlapping runs and one visible audit correction, so it shows campaign solution discovery rather than clean sequential-learning causality or a 72% single-episode success rate. The 9/50 pure-Engineer value is a historical comparison, not a replayable paired role ablation in this repository.
